title: UPI was never free. But is its new merchant fee fair?
summary: UPI's new MDR brings the cost of digital payments into focus. But questions remain over how the revenue will be distributed, whether smaller merchants and consumers will bear the burden, and if the framework adequately addresses competition and transparency in India's digital payments ecosystem.
llm_summary: UPI’s long‑standing “free” model is ending with a new merchant‑discount rate (MDR) that charges businesses for every digital transaction. While the move shines a light on how payment‑system revenues will be split, it raises concerns that smaller merchants and consumers could shoulder higher costs, and that the rules may not fully ensure competition or transparency in India’s fast‑growing digital payments landscape.
